setDefaultHint: Initial choice on the start panel; change per round anytime

stepsModeHint: How guided-step questions are answered this round (other types unaffected)

wordBookImportDesc: json ([{w,m}] array) or csv (word,meaning per line, UTF-8); switches after import

wordLookupHint: Type to search, Chinese meanings too

regenNoteHint: Optional. Tell AI what is wrong with this question
drillHint: Generate practice from weak points: wrong-question variants (template: most-missed real question) or concept checks; each question AI-verified; results land in a collection.
relatedHint: Questions related to this doc (knowledge backlinks & source); click to jump to the question block
relatedEmpty: No related questions in the bank yet
companionEnableDesc: A mascot companion at the bottom-right of the quiz tab and word panel: reacts and talks as you study
companionPersonaDesc: Voice style for fallback lines and AI replies; switchable anytime
companionAiDesc: Milestone lines via the built-in agent; click the mascot to chat or explain a wrong answer (off = local rule-based lines only)
companionModelHint: Empty = follow the default model in SiYuan AI settings

companionChatHello: I'm here. Chat when you need a break, or let me explain questions you got wrong.

knowHint: Docs linked by question refs appear automatically (derived from the bank); importing a shelf/book recursively expands all its sub-docs, shown even without questions.
knowEmpty: No knowledge docs yet: link via conversion (check the knowledge root), or import one manually.
matchHint: AI routes each question to link sections of "{doc}" onto the chosen bank.
